page.notes: Left margin references, in order: "1. Cor. 2. 6. 8." beside the line with "Apostolus"; "Ioh. 1. 47. & 7. 52." beside the line "ei cui fuit afflictio"; "Math. 11 13." beside the line "aperte consentiente"; "Matth. 4. 15." beside the last lines ("qui de tempore" / "Euangelij"). The Greek and Hebrew words are partly worn; the Greek of 1 Cor. 2:6,8 and the Hebrew pair (Isa. 9:1, probably הקל and הכביד) are uncertain. The ornament below the text is an engraving, not transcribed. The bullet-like dot at the left margin and the scan speckles are not printed text.
